leadText:
Mario (Japanese: モブオ Mobuo) is a character of the day who appeared in Dressed for Jess Success!. He is a Pokémon Coordinator.

Mario competed in the Lilypad Town Pokémon Contest, hoping to win the Ribbon with his . He passed through the Performance Stage, but he lost against and her in the quarterfinals.
